title: Private Property Protection Act of 2005
policy_area: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S10046)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text of measure as introduced: CR S10046)

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text of measure as introduced: CR S10046)

summaries.text:
Private Property Protection Act of 2005 - Prohibits federal funds from being used relating to a property that is the subject of a taking by eminent domain, unless the property is being used for public use or a public purpose.
 States that economic development, including an increase in the tax base, tax revenues, or employment, may not be the primary basis for establishing a public use or public purpose under this Act.
